body.description: Edit ONLY the white mask containing the single pale skeleton at crypt right center. Repose this ONE figure into a strong BACK-THREE-QUARTER elevated isometric view facing the upper-right diagonal tile axis. Show the REAR and SIDE of the cranium, not two frontal eye sockets; jaw seen from one side. Align both shoulders, hips, arms, equipment, boots and both soles along that same diagonal. Preserve the identity and equipment: pale skull, spear and compact bones. Preserve the exact compact scale and same foot anchor, with both soles inside its one full original diamond tile; no widening into neighboring cells. Keep crisp stepped pixels, palette, dark outlines, contact shadow and the original continuous room grid. Preserve every black-mask pixel exactly. Do not add a character, base, pedestal, platform, ring, glow or UI.
